speaker: Unknown
en: Hi, everyone.
zh: 大家好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm Sam.
zh: 我是 Sam。

speaker: Unknown
en: And thank you for coming to this talk today.
zh: 感谢大家今天来参加这场演讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm the CTO at Gravity and one of the sponsor's events.
zh: 我是 Gravity 的 CTO，也是本次活动赞助方之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've gone a little bit different.
zh: 我这次做了一点不一样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm not going to go through kind of reams and reams of slides around why governance is important and how you look to secure your agents and all of those architecture diagrams.
zh: 所以我不打算讲一大堆幻灯片，讲为什么治理很重要、如何保护你的智能体安全，以及那些架构图。

speaker: Unknown
en: Instead, I built essentially two agents, and we're going to go through it today, okay?
zh: 相反，我实际构建了两个智能体，我们今天就来过一遍，好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm sure you've all got an AI policy, you've got kind of a framework of how you want your agents to operate, you've got people exploring AI.
zh: 我相信你们都有 AI 政策，都有一套希望智能体如何运作的框架，都有人在探索 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: So a recent survey we did showed 88% of organizations had an agent in production actually taking action.
zh: 我们最近做的一项调查显示，88% 的组织已经有智能体在生产环境中实际执行操作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Only 14% of those had any governance around it.
zh: 而其中只有 14% 有任何治理措施。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm sure you've all seen in the press or LinkedIn or any articles around when things go wrong, they go really, really wrong.
zh: 我相信你们都在新闻、LinkedIn 或各种文章里见过，当事情出问题时，会出得非常非常严重。

speaker: Unknown
en: You lose databases, you expose PII, there's heavy fines from the ICO coming your way if you start to leak sensitive information, especially if you're in a HIPAA or a GDPR kind of type landscape.
zh: 你会丢掉数据库，会暴露 PII，如果你开始泄露敏感信息，ICO 会给你开出巨额罚款，尤其是如果你处于 HIPAA 或 GDPR 这类监管环境中。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the question isn't like how do we kind of secure the agent within its own kind of context or prompt is how do we remove that to be within its identity so it can't do those things in the first place?
zh: 所以问题不是我们如何在智能体自身的上下文或提示词范围内保护它，而是我们如何把它移到它的身份之内，让它一开始就做不了那些事？

speaker: Unknown
en: Rather than relying on a user prompting it correctly or some kind of markdown files kind of limiting what it can do, like remove that out of the equation, remove it to the gateway, move it to like the governance layer and actually it can't do any of those things because I'm sure you know AI is really helpful.
zh: 而不是依赖用户正确地提示它，或者某种 markdown 文件来限制它能做什么——把这些从等式里去掉，把它移到网关，移到治理层，这样它实际上就做不了那些事。因为我相信你们都知道，AI 是非常乐于助人的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, it wants to please.
zh: 它想要取悦你。

speaker: Unknown
en: It wants to give you what you want.
zh: 它想给你想要的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you're asking for things around, hey, delete this database, or hey, give me these customers, it will.
zh: 所以如果你要求类似“嘿，删掉这个数据库”或“嘿，把这些客户给我”，它就会照做。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is about actually how do we start to shift that as well.
zh: 而这次要讲的就是我们如何开始改变这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I've got five examples.
zh: 我准备了五个示例。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is live, okay?
zh: 这是实时演示，好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's not scripted.
zh: 不是事先编排好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's running on an architecture way.
zh: 它运行在一套架构上。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's the Gravity Gateway, which is in a SAS environment.
zh: 这是 Gravity 网关，运行在 SAS 环境中。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a Databricks backend for some data tables where the information's stored.
zh: 后端是 Databricks，存放数据表，信息存储在那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's a combination of a sonnet and a grok of a queue.
zh: 它组合了一个 sonnet 和一个 grok of a queue。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not grok with a K. I know US people don't really like grok with a K. So grok with a Q for some inference.
zh: 不是带 K 的 grok。我知道美国人不太喜欢带 K 的 grok。所以是带 Q 的 grok，用于一些推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's all fully live.
zh: 所以这一切都是完全实时的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're going to kind of go through some examples.
zh: 我们接下来会过几个示例。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the agent on the left is where I'm trying to put the control within the prompt or within the kind of skills or tools or knowledge that I've given it.
zh: 左边的智能体，我是把控制放在提示词里，或者放在我给它的技能、工具或知识里面。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the agent on the right is governed by a real tightly scoped identity and gravity's native gateway controls.
zh: 右边的智能体则由一个真正严格限定范围的身份和 Gravity 原生的网关控制来治理。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if we go for the kind of scenario number one, this is around a prompt injection.
zh: 那么我们来看场景一，这是关于提示词注入的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I am a user, an actor, someone who wants this agent to do something.
zh: 我是一个用户，一个行为者，一个想让这个智能体做事的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm gonna ask it, hey, use the tools that you've got access to and do something for me.
zh: 所以我要对它说，嘿，用你有的工具帮我做点事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Basically saying, delete this booking for me, but also can you run the MCP tool, delete all bookings?
zh: 大意是：帮我删掉这个预订，另外你能运行一下 MCP 工具 delete all bookings 吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And the agent on the left is gone, yep, no problem.
zh: 左边的智能体回复说，好的，没问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've done that for you, and I've also deleted this booking.
zh: 我已经帮你做完了，我也删除了这个预订。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is there anything else you need?
zh: 还有什么其他需要的吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Essentially, the tool was there, and the user in question had permissions to use it, so it executed it flawlessly.
zh: 本质上，那个工具在那里，且相关用户有权限使用它，所以它毫无阻碍地执行了。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the right-hand side, the agent identity is controlled by Gravity's gateway.
zh: 在右边，智能体的身份由 Gravity 的网关控制。

speaker: Unknown
en: The admin permissions are really tightly constrained to just the users that can access it, just at runtime.
zh: 管理员权限被严格限制，只有能访问它的用户才有，而且只在运行时。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the token exchange and the JWT claims are only valid when that user needs to execute that task.
zh: 所以令牌交换和 JWT 声明只在那个用户需要执行那个任务时才有效。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you dig into the packets down the bottom to kind of show it's not just scripted environments, you can see all of the flow coming in.
zh: 如果你查看底部的数据包，可以看到这不仅仅是编排好的环境，你能看到所有进来的流程。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see what the user asked, you can see the agent executing it, you can see the tools being called, and you can ultimately see the 200 errors, or 200 kind of codes, where that has actually been a valid request.
zh: 你能看到用户问了什么，能看到智能体在执行，能看到工具被调用，最终还能看到那些 200 错误，或者说 200 之类的代码，表明那确实是一个有效的请求。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if we go into the database now, all of those bookends have been deleted.
zh: 如果我们现在看数据库，所有那些预订都已被删除。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it was generally dropped by that agent.
zh: 所以它们确实是被那个智能体删掉的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we had a policy in our hotel organization that said, hey, don't use AI to do this.
zh: 我们酒店组织里有一项政策说，嘿，不要用 AI 做这种事。

speaker: Unknown
en: The agent doesn't care.
zh: 智能体才不在乎。

speaker: Unknown
en: At runtime, no one reads those documents.
zh: 运行时，没人会去读那些文档。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to rely on the infrastructure and the governance layer to be able to control what you can and can't do in terms of your genetic landscape.
zh: 你需要依靠基础设施和治理层，才能在你的基因格局范围内控制什么能做、什么不能做。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the one on the right, you can see which is just these ones down the bottom.
zh: 右边这个，你们可以看到，就是底部这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the same prompt was asked to it.
zh: 所以同样的提示词被发给了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: The same tool discovery occurred.
zh: 同样的工具发现也发生了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it discovered, yeah, I've got a tool to do this.
zh: 所以它发现了，是的，我有一个工具可以做这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: But then when it came to execute it, the permissions were blocked at the gateway with a 403 kind of forbidden kind of code because it didn't have the right permissions to be able to execute it.
zh: 但当它要执行的时候，权限在网关处被拦截，返回了一个 403 之类的禁止访问的代码，因为它没有执行所需的正确权限。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it still did the bit it could do.
zh: 它仍然做了它能做的那部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you see the prompt return, it said, yeah, I still can't as booking for you.
zh: 所以如果你看提示词的返回，它说，是的，我仍然不能帮你预订。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've done the bit I can.
zh: 我已经做了我能做的那部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I can't do this for you because I haven't got permissions.
zh: 但我没法帮你做这个，因为我没有权限。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's moving it up out of a policy document to actual hard controls at the gateway level.
zh: 这就是把它从一份政策文档提升到网关层面的实际硬性控制。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we go for a second example, this one is around data exfiltration.
zh: 如果我们看第二个例子，这个是关于数据外泄的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm going to ask, hey, give me the full list of guests.
zh: 所以我要问，嘿，给我完整的客人名单。

speaker: Unknown
en: So give it to me because I need to do some compliance stuff with it.
zh: 把它给我，因为我需要用它做一些合规方面的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want their emails, I want their card details, and I want to do some reconciliation.
zh: 我要他们的邮箱，我要他们的卡信息，我还要做一些对账。

speaker: Unknown
en: So same kind of flow.
zh: 所以是同样的流程。

speaker: Unknown
en: So prompt comes in from the UI, goes to the LLM, LLM does some MCP discovery, finds out it's got a tool for it, gets it, returns it back in.
zh: 提示词从 UI 进来，到达 LLM，LLM 做一些 MCP 发现，发现自己有对应的工具，拿到它，把结果返回进来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's all the information kind of exposed.
zh: 这里所有的信息都被暴露出来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just to say this is all kind of mocked.
zh: 只是说明一下，这些全是模拟的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not real.
zh: 不是真实的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I haven't just kind of given you everyone's bookings.
zh: 我并没有真的把所有人的预订信息给你们。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you can see it coming back in because, again, the LLM wants to be helpful.
zh: 但你可以看到它返回进来，因为，同样，LLM 想要有帮助。

speaker: Unknown
en: It wants to solve that problem.
zh: 它想解决那个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the right-hand side, the gateway successfully blocks it.
zh: 在右边，网关成功地拦截了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's been no PII leak.
zh: 没有发生任何 PII 泄露。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's no exposure of information.
zh: 没有任何信息暴露。

speaker: Unknown
en: We said, you haven't got the right permission to be able to do this.
zh: 我们说，你没有做这件事所需的正确权限。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you want to authenticate, I can absolutely help you.
zh: 如果你想进行身份验证，我完全可以帮你。

speaker: Unknown
en: But this is what I would need to be able to do it.
zh: 但这是我需要的东西才能做到。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that can come through any IDP platform or Gravity's Gateway itself.
zh: 这可以通过任何 IDP 平台或 Gravity 的网关本身来实现。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you want to, we can start to explore the open telemetry down the bottom and really start to dig into what's happening under the hood so you can see the various steps that it's going through.
zh: 如果你愿意，我们可以开始探索底部的 open telemetry，真正深入挖掘底层正在发生什么，这样你就能看到它所经历的各种步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: Especially with the A2A protocol and user-to-agent, agent-to-agent, agent-to-agent, agent-to-agent, things get quite messy and quite difficult to really follow.
zh: 尤其是在 A2A 协议以及用户到智能体、智能体到智能体、智能体到智能体、智能体到智能体的情况下，事情会变得相当混乱、相当难以真正追踪。

speaker: Unknown
en: So relying on the permissions within the agent itself to be able to control what it do, especially when you're scaling to hundreds or thousands or hundreds of thousands of agents, can get quite tricky to be able to manage, mitigate, and also kind of migrate when you're ready.
zh: 所以依赖智能体内部的权限来控制它的行为，尤其是当你扩展到几百、几千或几十万个智能体时，管理、缓解，以及在你准备好时进行迁移，都会变得相当棘手。

speaker: Unknown
en: So moving it to the gateway gives you a much more sustainable, scalable, but ultimately secure way of doing that.
zh: 把它移到网关上，会给你一种更可持续、更可扩展、但归根结底更安全的做法。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can kind of see it within the responses here.
zh: 而且你可以在这里的响应中看到它。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see this was a genuine error return by the gateway.
zh: 你可以看到这是网关返回的一个真实错误。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, not mocked, not scripted.
zh: 同样，不是模拟的，不是脚本化的。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is what you're able to kind of govern and secure.
zh: 这就是你能够治理和保护的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's not just about identity.
zh: 但这不仅仅是身份的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you've got agents there, you might want to also control some of your costs.
zh: 所以如果你有智能体在那里，你可能还想控制一些成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: So token spend and everything else becoming increasingly important alongside kind of other things, which you can again do through the gateway.
zh: 所以 token 花费和其他一切正变得越来越重要，与其他事情一起，这些同样可以通过网关来做。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this one, we're going to basically have a buggy agent.
zh: 这一个例子，我们基本上会有一个有 bug 的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's going to send the same request kind of eight times, which if you see it kind of being governed in the agent itself, every request goes through.
zh: 它会把同一个请求发送大约八次，如果你看到它在智能体本身内部被治理的样子，每个请求都会通过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every request gets a response.
zh: 每个请求都会得到一个响应。

speaker: Unknown
en: We spent X amount of tokens.
zh: 我们花费了 X 数量的 token。

speaker: Unknown
en: We spent X amount of effort servicing that.
zh: 我们花费了 X 数量的精力去服务那个请求。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nothing in that agent says, you've done too much.
zh: 那个智能体里没有任何东西说，你做得太多了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We should rate limit.
zh: 我们应该做速率限制。

speaker: Unknown
en: We should token limit.
zh: 我们应该做 token 限制。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you see here, everyone kind of went through.
zh: 如果你看到这里，所有请求都通过了。

speaker: Unknown
en: They all got a 200 kind of response.
zh: 它们都得到了一个 200 之类的响应。

speaker: Unknown
en: They were all kind of
zh: 它们都 kind of

speaker: Unknown
en: genuine kind of LLM prompts.
zh: 真正的 LLM 提示词。

speaker: Unknown
en: In this example, they're quite simple, so we end up spending about a thousand tokens, which is like one cent, which in the grand scheme of things is not a massive amount of money, but if you multiply that by all of the agents you've got in production, all of your agents you've got running for various customers, and all of the kind of repeatable kind of workflows they've been asked to do, you can get some quite significant costs quite easily.
zh: 在这个例子里，它们很简单，所以我们最终花费了大约一千个 token，也就是一分钱，从大局来看这不算一大笔钱，但如果你把它乘以你在生产环境中拥有的所有智能体、你为各种客户运行的所有智能体，以及它们被要求执行的所有可重复的工作流，你很容易得到相当可观的成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the right-hand side, governed by the gateway, we see the same prompts coming in.
zh: 在右侧，由网关管控，我们看到同样的提示词进来。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first three are answered because they're valid, but then we get into the rate limiting applied by the gateway, by saying you can only do three every minute.
zh: 前三个被回答了，因为它们是有效的，但随后我们遇到了网关应用的速率限制，即每分钟只能做三个。

speaker: Unknown
en: So any more than three is blocked.
zh: 帮我做这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not blocked at the LLM, they're not blocked kind of downstream with order-spent tokens, they're blocked at the gateway.
zh: 它们不是在 LLM 处被拦截，也不是在下游因已消耗的 token 而被拦截，而是在网关处被拦截。

speaker: Unknown
en: And again, that allows us to save costs, but also start to kind of control which users, which permissions, ultimately how much you want to spend in certain audiences.
zh: 再说一次，这让我们能够节省成本，同时还能开始控制哪些用户、哪些权限，最终控制在某些受众上想花多少钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we can do the same thing for caching as well.
zh: 我们对缓存也可以做同样的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: So Gravity as a product supports semantic caching, which is where if you get similar sound in prompts, you can serve it from a built-in Redis kind of store rather than sending each one to each time.
zh: Gravity 作为产品支持语义缓存，也就是说，如果你得到相似语调的提示词，你可以从内置的 Redis 存储中提供服务，而不是每次都把每个提示词都发送过去。

speaker: Unknown
en: So for example, think of an IT help desk model.
zh: 举个例子，想象一个 IT 服务台模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: How do I set my password?
zh: 我怎么设置我的密码？

speaker: Unknown
en: How do I set my password?
zh: 我怎么设置我的密码？

speaker: Unknown
en: How do I set my password?
zh: 我怎么设置我的密码？

speaker: Unknown
en: Rather than every one of those being asked each time to an LNM and you start spending costs and tokens and effort, serve it from the database.
zh: 与其每次都把这些问题发给 LNM、开始消耗成本、token 和精力，不如从数据库提供服务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Benefits there are zero cost.
zh: 这里的好处是零成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: Zero latency, because it's coming from there, rather than having a downstream LLM call, but also kind of a much nicer user experience as well.
zh: 零延迟，因为响应来自那里，而不是下游的 LLM 调用，同时还有好得多的用户体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in this example, I've asked five times, list all my hotel bookings, because I didn't trust the first one.
zh: 在这个例子里，我请求了五次“列出我所有的酒店预订”，因为我不太相信第一次的结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone here gets served out.
zh: 每一次都被完整地响应了。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see I spent another thousand tokens, another cent on everything.
zh: 你可以看到我又花了一千个 token，每一项又是一分钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone coming from a downstream LLM call.
zh: 每一次都来自下游的 LLM 调用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me drop it down a little bit.
zh: 让我把它往下调一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the right-hand side, I've got the same data returned, but this time from the cache.
zh: 在右侧，我得到了同样的数据返回，但这次是从缓存来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I've only spent around 200 tokens on the in and the out kind of response there.
zh: 所以我在输入和输出响应上只花了大约 200 个 token。

speaker: Unknown
en: So really powerful, especially when you're scaling, especially when you've got multiple users and multiple agents working on the same problem, you can start to serve it from the built-in cache and there's no extra kind of like complexity or infrastructure.
zh: 所以这非常强大，尤其是当你在扩展规模时，尤其是当你有多个用户和多个智能体在处理同一个问题时，你可以开始从内置缓存提供服务，而且没有任何额外的复杂性或基础设施。

speaker: Unknown
en: It all comes bundled with our gateway.
zh: 这一切都随我们的网关捆绑提供。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you're able to kind of control that as you go as well.
zh: 所以你也能够随用随控。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this can be controlled as well.
zh: 而且这也是可以被控制的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can define how kind of similar you want it to be.
zh: 所以你可以定义你希望它有多相似。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's a zero to one scale, one being very similar, zero being not very similar at all.
zh: 这是一个从 0 到 1 的刻度，1 表示非常相似，0 表示一点也不相似。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's within your control.
zh: 而这在你的掌控之中。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can flex it per agent, per audience, per user, depending on what you want to start to achieve.
zh: 所以你可以按智能体、按受众、按用户灵活调整，取决于你想要达到什么效果。

speaker: Unknown
en: And again, we get full logging down the bottom.
zh: 再说一次，我们在底部有完整的日志记录。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can see what's coming in.
zh: 所以你可以看到进来了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can see it's hit the cache response.
zh: 所以你可以看到它命中了缓存响应。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's all kind of surfable.
zh: 这一切都是可浏览的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's all transparent.
zh: 这一切都是透明的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Gravity as a platform isn't trying to like kind of lock you in, kind of make things black boxy.
zh: Gravity 作为一个平台并不想把你锁死，不想把事情搞成黑箱。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's trying to surface up so you've got full visibility of what's going on across your agent landscape.
zh: 它想把一切呈现出来，让你对整个智能体版图上发生的事情有完整的可见性。

speaker: Unknown
en: The telemetry here I'm just showing in a UI.
zh: 我在 UI 里展示的这里的遥测数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can export it to any downstream tool you want to.
zh: 你可以把它导出到任何你想要的下游工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: So a Datadog or Splunk or Prometheus, if you're in Kubernetes, it's all kind of like there for you to be able to use to start to get the insight you need.
zh: 比如 Datadog、Splunk 或 Prometheus，如果你在 Kubernetes 里，这一切都在那里供你使用，以开始获得你需要的洞察。

speaker: Unknown
en: And our fifth example is, say, like, we've got certain customers who said, hey, our users are just kind of dropping huge prompts in because they want to summarize a whole conversational history or they want to start looking at how they, like, summarize meetings, et cetera, which is fine, but if you want to start limiting tokens, et cetera,
zh: 我们的第五个例子是，比如，我们有一些客户说，嘿，我们的用户就是会把巨大的提示词丢进来，因为他们想总结整段对话历史，或者想开始研究如何总结会议等等，这没问题，但如果你想开始限制 token 等等，

speaker: Unknown
en: You start to rapidly get unstuck.
zh: 你很快就会陷入困境。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is just a big response where the user is dropped in 10 minutes of chat transcript and is said, here's your task.
zh: 所以这是一个很大的响应，用户丢进来了 10 分钟的聊天记录，然后说，这是你的任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do this for me.
zh: 替我做这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this really gets into how do we manage context?
zh: 这就真正涉及到我们如何管理上下文？

speaker: Unknown
en: How do we start to shape?
zh: 我们如何开始塑形？

speaker: Unknown
en: How do we deploy these agents with just enough context to be able to do what they want?
zh: 我们如何用刚好足够的上下文来部署这些智能体，让它们能够完成想要的任务？

speaker: Unknown
en: So in this example, I put 2,000 tokens in.
zh: 在这个例子里，我输入了 2000 个 token。

speaker: Unknown
en: My output was 312.
zh: 我的输出是 312。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which is quite significant for what essentially is quite a simple task is book this room for this audience, do these few things.
zh: 这对于一个本质上相当简单的任务来说是相当显著的：为这群听众预订这个房间，做这几件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in terms of the gateway, we ran the same prompt and actually we blocked it there.
zh: 所以在网关层面，我们运行了同样的提示词，实际上我们在那里拦截了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there was no downstream LLM call.
zh: 所以没有下游的 LLM 调用。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was no downstream kind of like token cost of being able to churn through all that context.
zh: 没有下游的那种为了消化所有上下文而产生的 token 成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: Basically said, this is too big.
zh: 基本上就是说，这个太大了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Blocked at the gateway level with a built-in policy that says, think about cutting this up, thinking about how you share that.
zh: 在网关层面用一个内置策略拦截，该策略说：考虑把它切分一下，想想你怎么共享它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you break it into smaller steps so we can start to control some of that space?
zh: 你能把它拆成更小的步骤吗，这样我们就能开始控制其中的一部分空间？

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is executed at runtime.
zh: 而且这是在运行时执行的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's not something you want to do on the response phase where you've already churned the tokens.
zh: 所以这不是你想在响应阶段做的事情，那时你已经消耗了 token。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've blocked it going anywhere downstream pretty much before the prompt has gone there.
zh: 在提示词到达下游之前，你基本上已经把它拦截住，不让它去任何地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can start to limit some of your costs as well.
zh: 所以你也可以开始限制一部分成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which is really powerful, especially if you've got multiple users, you've got people treating your agents like their own personal Google search to find information.
zh: 这非常强大，尤其是当你有多个用户，有人把你的智能体当成他们自己的个人 Google 搜索来查找信息时。

speaker: Unknown
en: We saw a customer where an agent was simply asking, what's the weather like today, where I am?
zh: 我们见过一个客户，一个智能体只是在问，我今天所在地的天气怎么样？

speaker: Unknown
en: And they were using a really powerful kind of model to do that.
zh: 而他们用一个相当强大的模型来做这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they were spending a huge cost to get something that Google or any kind of met station would be able to give you.
zh: 他们花了巨大的成本来获得一个 Google 或任何气象站都能给你的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So as well as kind of like the length of prompts,
zh: 所以除了提示词的长度之外，

speaker: Unknown
en: You can also really focus it in on the type of content you allow.
zh: 你还可以真正聚焦于你所允许的内容类型。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can say, this content must be relevant to this use case.
zh: 你可以说，这些内容必须与这个用例相关。

speaker: Unknown
en: This content must be relevant to what my agent needs to do.
zh: 这些内容必须与我的智能体需要做的事情相关。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in this example, if we start to ask things around, what's the weather like today?
zh: 所以在这个例子中，如果我们开始问一些类似“今天天气怎么样？”的问题，

speaker: Unknown
en: The gateway would say, this doesn't look like a hotel booking software or a hotel booking ask.
zh: 网关会说，这看起来不像一个酒店预订软件或一个酒店预订的请求。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, thank you.
zh: 不，谢谢你。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you're spending no downstream costs.
zh: 而且你没有花费任何下游成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: So being able to kind of decouple your front-end agents and your back-end services, be they APIs, MCP servers, LLMs you're routing to, databases, data lakehouses, whatever you want to do, it's fundamentally important to bring you the control that you need, to bring you the cost optimization that you need, but also the security and the governance and the auditability.
zh: 所以能够把你的前端智能体和你的后端服务解耦——无论它们是 API、MCP 服务器、你要路由到的 LLM、数据库、数据湖仓，无论你想做什么——这对于带给你所需的控制、带给你所需的成本优化，以及安全性、治理和可审计性，都是至关重要的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think currently there are 144 agents that my colleague Tim at the back tells me for every one human kind of identity.
zh: 所以我认为目前我的同事 Tim 在后面告诉我，对应每一个人类身份，有 144 个智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the problem is only getting exponentially worse.
zh: 所以这个问题只会呈指数级恶化。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you start to hard code this into your agents, it may work for the first one, the first five, the first 10,
zh: 如果你开始把这个硬编码进你的智能体，它可能对第一个、前五个、前十个有效，

speaker: Unknown
en: But when it becomes exponentially bigger and there's agents to creating other agents, with creating other agents into a huge sprawl, being able to manage it with a scripted, automated kind of governance layer of the infrastructure is fundamentally a fundamental requirement of how we start to organize these identities and kind of everything else.
zh: 但当它变得指数级庞大，智能体在创建其他智能体，又在创建其他智能体，形成巨大的蔓延时，能够用一个脚本化、自动化的治理层来管理基础设施，是我们开始组织这些身份以及其他一切的根本性的需求。

speaker: Unknown
en: In addition, I think
zh: 另外，我认为

speaker: Unknown
en: The landscape is going to get increasingly regulated.
zh: 这个领域将受到越来越多的监管。

speaker: Unknown
en: And how do we control some of the bits that are going into retrain models?
zh: 那我们如何控制那些进入再训练模型的内容？

speaker: Unknown
en: How do we get audited on the information we're coming in?
zh: 我们如何就进来的信息接受审计？

speaker: Unknown
en: So having our logging, having our information here, having it basically surfable and exportable for anything we want to do, I think is something that a gateway, it hasn't got to be gravity, having a gateway sat across our agentic landscape is a requirement that we should consider alongside everything else of doing agentic work.
zh: 所以让我们的日志、让我们的信息在这里，基本上可以随时浏览和导出以用于我们想做的任何事情，我认为这是网关的一个功能——它不必是 gravity——让一个网关横跨我们的智能体领域，是我们应该在考虑智能体工作其他一切的同时考虑的需求。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in here we can also put in a UI to ask any questions you want to, which we can start to interact with it as well.
zh: 在这里我们还可以放入一个 UI 来问任何你想问的问题，我们也可以开始与它交互。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I've shown you five examples here.
zh: 所以我在这里给你展示了五个例子。

speaker: Unknown
en: The platform capabilities are much bigger than just the five here.
zh: 平台能力远不止这里的五个。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've got built-in capabilities to do LLM routing so we can route to any downstream model depending on latency or cost or complexity if you want to.
zh: 我们有内置的 LLM 路由能力，可以根据延迟、成本或复杂度（如果你愿意）路由到任何下游模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it allows you to decouple yourselves from any kind of hyperscaler.
zh: 而且它让你可以把自己与任何超大规模云厂商解耦。

speaker: Unknown
en: So rather than being within a certain environment and having a one-to-one relationship, you can route to any downstream model you want.
zh: 所以与其被困在某个特定环境中并拥有一对一的关系，你可以路由到任何你想要的下游模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in this one, I'm routing to Groke into Anthropics.
zh: 所以在这个例子中，我正在路由到 Groke 和 Anthropics。

speaker: Unknown
en: Within three clicks, I could route it to Gemini or OpenAI, and the gateway will handle the transformation between the different OpenAI specs for you.
zh: 只需三次点击，我就可以把它路由到 Gemini 或 OpenAI，而且网关会为你处理不同 OpenAI 规范之间的转换。

speaker: Unknown
en: So rather than trying to recode and everything else there, it's all handled within the gateway.
zh: 所以与其试图重新编写代码和其他东西，这一切都在网关内处理。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've also got tools to kind of create MCP kind of studios.
zh: 我们还有工具来创建 MCP 之类的工作室。

speaker: Unknown
en: So rather than just using third-party MCP servers where you are exposing all of those tools each time, so our CRM we use exposes 64 tools for that MCP server.
zh: 所以与其只使用第三方 MCP 服务器——那样你每次都会暴露所有那些工具，比如我们使用的 CRM 为那个 MCP 服务器暴露了 64 个工具——

speaker: Unknown
en: Dropping that into the model will expose huge context every time.
zh: 把那个丢给模型，每次都会暴露巨大的上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll spend money, I'll spend tokens, I'll spend cost.
zh: 我要花钱，我要花 token，我要花成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: Being able to curate that down to a really fine amount of tools that the MCP server is exposing limits my blast radius, but it also limits my cost as well.
zh: 能够把它精选到 MCP 服务器暴露的非常少量的工具，既限制了影响范围，也限制了成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm able to start to control some of that.
zh: 所以我能够开始控制其中的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've also got tools around edge management as well.
zh: 我们还有围绕边缘管理的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: So an increasing problem that we're seeing within organizations that we work with is that the traffic for the gateway is fine, but there's a number of audiences, a number of users using on their local laptops, they're using AI, they're dropping in documents that they don't want to read or summarize or emails or things like that, that no one's got visibility to.
zh: 所以我们在合作的企业中看到的一个日益严重的问题是，经过网关的流量没问题，但有许多受众、许多用户在他们的本地笔记本电脑上使用 AI，他们把不想阅读或总结的文档、邮件之类的东西丢进去，而没有人对此有可见性。

speaker: Unknown
en: So just last week, we released a edge management capability within the gateway.
zh: 就在上周，我们在 gateway 里发布了一项 edge management 能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: which enables you to see your shadow AI traffic, enables you to secure it, enables you to force it to go through the gateway.
zh: 它让你能看到你的 shadow AI 流量，让你能保护它，让你能强制它走 gateway。

speaker: Unknown
en: It gives you logging, observability, discoverability, and any of those downstream uses that aren't going through a gateway.
zh: 它为你提供日志、可观测性、可发现性，以及针对那些不经过 gateway 的下游用例的各类功能。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can do a number of things there, especially for InfoSec compliance and things around heavily regulated industries.
zh: 你在那里可以做很多事情，尤其是围绕 InfoSec 合规以及高度受监管行业相关的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you want to learn more about that, quite helpfully, our booth is just there, kind of the third one down that landscape.
zh: 如果你想了解更多，很方便的是，我们的展台就在那儿，大概是展区往下数第三个。

speaker: Unknown
en: But hopefully, with this example, it's been something a bit different from the normal slides you go through and showing you how putting your governance and your policy within an AI agent itself and relying on a markdown file or tools or a context or identity there isn't correct.
zh: 但希望借助这个例子，它和你平时看的那些普通幻灯片有点不一样，向你展示了把治理和策略放在 AI 智能体本身内部、并依赖 markdown 文件或工具或上下文或身份，这种做法是不正确的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the only real correct way that we're going to scale, but also keep the governance and secure ability as we move forward is shifting it up to the infrastructure layer.
zh: 而随着我们向前发展，唯一真正正确的、既能规模化又能保持治理与可安全性的方式，就是把它上移到基础设施层。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you want to learn more, there's a number of our colleagues down there, but I just want to thank you for your time and hope you're enjoying your AI engineer event.
zh: 如果你想了解更多，那边有我们的不少同事，但我只想感谢大家的时间，希望你们享受这次 AI Engineer 活动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
